selection_policy: Exact same task/method/objective/replica and planner seed; first terminal only; no best-of.
statistical_policy: 95% scene-cluster bootstrap, PCG64 seed45827,2000 replicates. All paired observations from a scene stay together; fewer than2 clusters has no CI.
cost_policy: Costs only on common numerical successes; differences are new minus old. Cold time also includes completed failures. Unstarted/pending jobs are never failures.
frontend_policy: Full-flow success denominator is every completed legal query. Local optimizer conditional denominator is independently validated DRM frontends; independent OMPL is not assigned a DRM denominator.

metric_definitions.joint_range_scaled_length: saved normalized_path_length: sum_i ||(q[i+1]-q[i])/(upper-lower)||_2; not length divided by endpoint chord
metric_definitions.endpoint_detour_ratio: path_length_rad / ||q_goal-q_start||_2 is a different metric and is not computed or relabelled here

configuration_audit.interpretation: Exact per-method declared configuration comparison. Check critical_protocol_checks before claiming a cap/solver change. Active differences are individually classified; other-method configuration blocks are inactive for the method being compared. Source hashes are retained separately, so matching configuration alone is not a claim of identical implementations. Historical OMPL source/native-parameter evidence is recorded for the now-explicit disabled observer settings.

interpretation: Paired before/after comparison of the declared repaired pipeline. The configuration audit records every changed field. OMPL native planning cap changed as recorded in ompl_native_cap_changes; in the completed-repair protocol this is10 to60 seconds, still bounded by the common remaining deadline minus reserves. Its effects cannot be attributed solely to DRM/NTO implementation fixes. Each pipeline retains its actual source/limits; this is not a single-factor causal ablation. The selected historical cohort already used EI-ZO max_iterations=30 and LGCS SCIP. NTO_PAPER versus NTO_REFINED also differs in clearance/refinement/solver settings.
